entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Tyumen State Medical University is a state institution of higher professional education and science, located in the city of Tyumen, Russia. Since 1963, it has trained over 25 thousand doctors. Graduates of this university are almost all the chief doctors of medical institutions and health care managers in the Tyumen and Kurgan regions, as well as the Khanty-Mansiysk Autonomous Okrug and Yamal. The third generation of scientists “raised” within its walls is already working at the university.
